_comment: Manual central-bank policy-rate fallback, read by fetch_macro.py. Used ALWAYS for IN (no reliable FRED series exists for RBI's repo rate) and as a fallback for US/UK/JP if FRED_KEY is unset or the FRED call fails. Update after each central-bank meeting; two-source-check before editing.

IN.note: Repo rate raised 25bp to 5.50% (unanimous) at the 5-7 Oct 2026 MPC; stance changed to calibrated tightening.

US.note: Midpoint of the 3.75%-4.00% target range: raised 25bp on 2026-09-16, held 10-2 on 2026-10-28. Next meeting 8-9 Dec 2026.

UK.note: Bank Rate raised 25bp to 4.00% (8-1; one vote for 4.25%) at the meeting ending 2026-11-04, announced 2026-11-05. Next announcement 17 Dec 2026.

JP.note: Policy rate raised to 1.25% on 2026-09-18; held 8-1 on 2026-10-30. Next meeting 17-18 Dec 2026.
